description: This file defines a Java interface named FileRemove that declares methods for removing files within a content management system, specifically for a sales manager application.

classes.name: FileRemove
classes.description: Java interface for file removal operations in the CMS module.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file identified by filename and content type for a given merchant store code.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with the specified merchant store code.
